event.title: Acme renewal risk review
event.purpose: Decide whether to offer an implementation extension before renewal.

attendee_notes.subject: Maya Chen
attendee_notes.text: Maya owns the renewal plan and asked for a direct blocker list before the call.

attendee_notes.subject: Jordan Lee
attendee_notes.text: Jordan is accountable for Acme rollout operations and requested a support timeline.

thread_snippets.text: Acme has two unresolved launch blockers: SSO mapping and CSV import validation.
Acme will decide renewal next Friday if the implementation plan is credible.

public_links.summary: Public project note says CSV import validation is in beta.
